title: Weak equivalences of Kan fibrations over arbitrary simplicial bases
statement: Use simplicial sets, weak homotopy equivalences and Kan fibrations of [lem-coef-kan-quillen-right-proper]. Let $B$ be any small simplicial set, let $p:E\to B$ and $q:T\to B$ be Kan fibrations, and let $u:E\to T$ satisfy $qu=p$. For each vertex $b\in B_0$, define the strict simplicial fibers $E_b=E\times_B\Delta^0$ and $T_b=T\times_B\Delta^0$ using the constant simplex at $b$. These fibers are Kan complexes. Then $u$ is a weak homotopy equivalence if and only if every $u_b:E_b\to T_b$ is a weak homotopy equivalence. Neither $B$, $E$ nor $T$ is required to be a Kan complex; empty bases and empty fibers are allowed.
